The '''flux cannon''' was a type of emplacement weapon developed by the [[Anomid/Legends|Anomid]] [[Schism Collective]] that was able to destroy [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]] in a single blast. The [[Emperor's Fortress]] was equipped with a number of flux cannons, which the Collective constructed when [[Darth Malgus]] seized the [[Space station/Legends|space station]] as his own.
